entity: American Chemical Society, Division of Polymer Chemistry (POLY): acs-poly-fall-show
decision: exclude — not an Atlas event series
notes: Organizer's statement (https://polyacs.org/poly-at-previous-national-acs-meetings/): "The POLY Division has organized and run symposia at National Meetings of the American Chemical Society for decades.". Organizer identifies embedded POLY symposia at ACS meetings; no separate Fall Show series is established. Polymer programming cannot qualify the general ACS parent.

entity: Kent State University Advanced Materials and Liquid Crystal Institute: amlci-materials-day-polymers-and-elastomers
decision: exclude — not an Atlas event series
notes: Organizer's statement (https://www.kent.edu/amlci/materialsday): "The theme of AMLCI Materials Day 2027 (MD27) “Ferroelectric Nematics” recognizes the recent excitement around this and related ferroelectric phases of matter.". Polymers & Elastomers is the 2026 edition theme; the recurring materials series changes themes, including Optics & Devices in 2024 and Ferroelectric Nematics in 2027.

entity: Association for Materials Protection and Performance (AMPP): ampp-annual-conference-expo
notes: Organizer's statement (https://ace.ampp.org/exhibitors): "the world’s largest corrosion and coatings tradeshow.". Coatings are explicitly co-primary across the whole tradeshow, supporting IN; the broader corrosion and materials-protection remit supports OUT under a strict primary-subject reading.

Organizer's statement (https://www.compositesworld.com/news/cw-issues-call-for-speakers-for-carbon-fiber-2026): "the materials, technologies and trends shaping the entire carbon fiber value chain". Entire carbon-fiber value chain is the named remit; composites manufacturing is prominent in the program, but polymer-composites primacy is not explicit.

Organizer's statement (https://www.admmontreal.com/en/show-brands/expoplast/): "Plastics is one of six sectors at ADM Montréal.". EXPOPLAST survives in the title and plastics-only description, supporting IN; the current body calls it one sector of one ADM event, supporting OUT under the separate-series rule.

entity: Geosynthetic Materials Association, Advanced Textiles Association: geosynthetics-conference
decision: exclude — not an Atlas event series
notes: Organizer's statement (https://geosyntheticsconference.com/event/fundamentals-of-geosynthetics/): "the various types of geosynthetic materials, applications and functions of the materials, and the various synthetic polymers used in manufacturing geosynthetics.". Geosynthetics is the named primary subject and its fundamentals name synthetic polymers; reasonable readers may differ on whether this establishes a polymer-materials series or broader geotechnical applications.

entity: Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH & Co. KG (Messe Stuttgart): moulding-expo
decision: exclude — not an Atlas event series
notes: Organizer's statement (https://www.messe-stuttgart.de/moulding-expo/en/): "International Trade Fair for Tool, Pattern and Mould Making". Primary subject is material-agnostic toolmaking; its official profile places plastics/elastomer tooling alongside metal casting, forming, forging and glass/ceramics tooling.

Organizer's statement (https://radtech.org/intro-to-uv-eb/): "UV and EB curing refers to a special way in which coatings, inks, adhesives, composites and other materials may be cured (dried)". Organizer defines the named UV/EB subject as curing coatings, adhesives and composites; the event program centers formulation chemistry, resins and curing.

Organizer's statement (https://biz.nikkan.co.jp/eve/sampe/overview.html): "SAMPE Japan was established in 1984 to provide "Living Intelligence and Experience Networks" for the advanced materials and processing technologies, including composite materials.". Broad advanced-materials remit includes metals and ceramics; named program strongly emphasizes composites/CFRP, making primary-subject qualification debatable.

Organizer's statement (https://www.thetire-cologne.com/for-exhibitors/become-an-exhibitor/benefits-as-an-exhibitor/): "THE TIRE COLOGNE covers the entire global market in all relevant areas - from tyres and rims to innovative workshop solutions and recycling.". Named tyres, retreading and tire recycling support a rubber-subfield reading; the primary tyre/wheel trade and workshop remit supports OUT because rubber is not named as primary.

Organizer's statement (https://www.tyrexpoasia.com/exhibitor-profile/): "As a trusted trade platform for the tyre and automotive aftermarket, TyreXpo Asia Singapore brings together manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, equipment suppliers, and service providers". Named tyre production, vulcanisation and rubber compounds support IN; the wider automotive-aftermarket primary remit supports OUT. AutoMROtive is a separate co-located show.
